notes: Synthetic English lead call. Covers: a commitment with a detail added a turn later, a client-side commitment, a topic that is not a commitment, a commitment walked back two turns later, and a delegated commitment restated by the delegate.

segments.speaker: Owner
segments.text: Thanks for joining. Let's go through the pricing questions first and then the rollout.

segments.speaker: Client 1
segments.text: Sure. Our board wants a number before the end of the month.

segments.speaker: Owner
segments.text: Understood. I'll send you the pricing deck on Friday, with the two options we discussed.

segments.speaker: Client 1
segments.text: Friday works. Can you also include the onboarding session in the line items?

segments.speaker: Owner
segments.text: Yes, I'll add the onboarding session to the deck.

segments.speaker: Team 1
segments.text: On the rollout, the SSO piece depends on your IT team. Who should we talk to?

segments.speaker: Client 1
segments.text: That's Marta. I'll introduce you to her by email this week.

segments.speaker: Owner
segments.text: Great. We should probably think about a training video at some point too.

segments.speaker: Client 1
segments.text: Maybe. Not a priority for us right now.

segments.speaker: Team 1
segments.text: Okay. I'll set up the staging workspace so your team can try it before the deck arrives.

segments.speaker: Client 1
segments.text: Actually, hold off on staging until we've seen the pricing. No point setting it up if we don't proceed.

segments.speaker: Team 1
segments.text: Fair enough, I'll wait on that then.

segments.speaker: Owner
segments.text: One more thing: the data export. You asked about it last time.

segments.speaker: Client 1
segments.text: Right. Could you send us a sample export so our analysts can check the format?

segments.speaker: Owner
segments.text: Will do. I'll ask Team 1 to send a sample export tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Team 1
segments.text: I'll send the sample export tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Client 1
segments.text: Perfect. And we'll review internally and come back to you by the 30th.
